blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Pope Leo XIV has approved the election of Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle as dean of the College of Cardinals. The approval comes following the resignation of 92-year-old Cardinal Giovanni Battista Re, who had held the post since January 2020. The Holy Father accepted Re’s resignation and granted him the title of dean emeritus of the College of Cardinals. Re will retain the title of the Suburbicarian Church of Sabina-Poggio Mirteto. Tagle, who serves as pro-prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization’s Section for First Evangelization and New Particular Churches, was elected by the cardinals of the Order of Bishops.
